title: Account Command Group (add, list, remove, show, set-default, re-auth)
description: Implement all six account subcommands. account add is the most complex — it validates credentials, calls the Zoho user-info API, enforces the ZohoCorp block, stores credentials in the keychain, and persists account metadata. account remove revokes the server-side token before clearing local storage. re-auth explicitly refreshes the token using stored credentials.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1-3 complete. AccountStore, OAuthProvider, ZohoCorpGuard, DcResolver all exist. IOutputWriter, ZapiCliException, ErrorCodes all wired. Program.cs DI working.
goal: All six account subcommands work end-to-end. After 'zapi-cli account add --name work --token xxx --client-id yyy --client-secret zzz', the account is persisted to accounts.json, credentials stored in keychain, and the tool outputs a success JSON. 'zapi-cli account list' returns a JSON array.
scope: Create src/ZapiCli/Commands/AccountCommands.cs with all six command classes.

AccountAddSettings inherits GlobalSettings with: [CommandOption("--name")] required string Name, [CommandOption("--token")] required string Token, [CommandOption("--client-id")] required string ClientId, [CommandOption("--client-secret")] required string ClientSecret, [CommandOption("--dc")] string Dc = "us". Validate() rejects if Name/Token/ClientId/ClientSecret are null/empty (INVALID_ARGS). Validate() rejects if Dc is not one of the 9 valid values.

AccountAddCommand.ExecuteAsync flow: (1) Validate all required args present; (2) Validate account name not already in accounts.json (ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS); (3) Resolve Accounts URL via DcResolver.GetAccountsBaseUrl(settings.Dc); (4) GET {accountsBaseUrl}/oauth/user/info with Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken {settings.Token}; (5) If HTTP error → ZapiCliException(AUTH_FAILURE, 2); (6) Parse Email + Zuid/ZPUID from response — if Email absent → ZapiCliException(EMAIL_REQUIRED, 1); (7) ZohoCorpGuard.AssertNotZohoCorp(email); (8) OAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync(name, token, clientId, clientSecret); (9) Build AccountEntry with Dc, Email, Zuid, Scopes=[], IsDefault=(no existing accounts); (10) AccountStore.SaveAsync; (11) IOutputWriter.WriteJson({ status='ok', data = { name, dc } }).
Use IHttpClientFactory to get an HttpClient for the user-info call in AccountAddCommand. Set a 30-second timeout. Do NOT reuse ApiClient here (circular dependency risk; ApiClient is Story 5).
AccountListCommand.ExecuteAsync: load AccountsRoot, project to list of { name, dc, email, is_default, needs_reauth, scope_count=scopes.Count } objects with token masked. WriteJson the array.
AccountShowSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--name")] required string Name.
AccountShowCommand.ExecuteAsync: FindAsync by name (ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND if null). WriteJson the account object with 'token': '***' added. Do NOT include actual token or client credentials in output.
AccountSetDefaultSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--name")] required string Name.
AccountSetDefaultCommand.ExecuteAsync: FindAsync, set IsDefault=true on target, set IsDefault=false on all others, SaveAsync. WriteJson({ status='ok', data={ name } }).
AccountRemoveSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--name")] required string Name.

AccountRemoveCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) FindAsync (ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND if absent); (2) Attempt token revocation — GET/POST Zoho OAuth revoke endpoint: POST {DcResolver.GetAccountsBaseUrl(account.Dc)}/oauth/v2/token/revoke with form body token={access_token from keychain}; on failure log warning and continue; (3) OAuthProvider.ClearTokenAsync (best-effort); (4) Remove AccountEntry from accounts.json; (5) If removed account was default and others remain, set first remaining as default; (6) SaveAsync; (7) WriteJson({ status='ok', data={ name } }).
AccountReAuthSettings inherits GlobalSettings: [CommandOption("--name")] required string Name.

AccountReAuthCommand.ExecuteAsync: (1) FindAsync (ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND if absent); (2) ZohoCorpGuard.AssertNotZohoCorp(account.Email); (3) OAuthProvider.RefreshTokenAsync(name, account.Scopes, account.Dc); (4) Set NeedsReauth=false in AccountEntry; (5) SaveAsync; (6) WriteJson({ status='ok', data={ name } }).
Register all six commands under the 'account' branch in Program.cs CommandApp.

Unit tests: AccountAddCommand with duplicate name → ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS; with ZohoCorp email → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, keychain write never called; with missing email from user-info → EMAIL_REQUIRED, keychain write never called; with missing --token → INVALID_ARGS; AccountRemoveCommand removes entry from accounts.json; AccountSetDefaultCommand updates is_default correctly; AccountListCommand masks token in output.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
account add with valid args stores credentials in keychain and writes { "status": "ok", "data": { "name": "...", "dc": "us" } } to stdout
account add with a ZohoCorp email aborts: IKeychainProvider.SetAsync never called, accounts.json not modified, ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED on stderr
account add where user-info returns no email aborts with EMAIL_REQUIRED, no keychain write
account add with duplicate name → ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS on stderr
account add with missing --token/--client-id/--client-secret → INVALID_ARGS before any network call
account list returns JSON array with no token values present — token masked as '***' in account show
account set-default updates is_default correctly across all accounts in accounts.json
account remove clears keychain entry and removes from accounts.json; token revocation attempted (best-effort)
account re-auth calls RefreshTokenAsync and sets NeedsReauth=false
contextForAgent: account add is the most security-sensitive command. The ZohoCorp check MUST run AFTER fetching the user-info (to get the email) and BEFORE any keychain write. Order: (1) arg validation, (2) uniqueness check, (3) user-info fetch, (4) email absence check, (5) ZohoCorp check, (6) keychain write, (7) accounts.json write. If any step fails, no subsequent step runs. The user-info API endpoint per DC is DcResolver.GetAccountsBaseUrl(dc) + '/oauth/user/info'. Parse 'Email' and 'ZPUID' from the response (see OQ-004). AccountShow must show all account fields but with 'token': '***' — do NOT add a Token property to AccountEntry; instead, synthesize a masked view object for output. Read ADR-0002 §account add Flow for the complete step sequence. Read OQ-001 for the output contradiction resolution — use { status, data } wrapper as authoritative.

openItems.item: User-info endpoint and response field names
openItems.defaultAssumption: See OQ-004. GET {DcResolver.GetAccountsBaseUrl(dc)}/oauth/user/info with Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken <token>. Parse 'Email' (string) and 'ZPUID' (string, used as Zuid). If either is absent, abort with EMAIL_REQUIRED.
See OQ-008. POST {DcResolver.GetAccountsBaseUrl(dc)}/oauth/v2/token/revoke. Form body: token=<access_token>. On failure, log warning and continue local cleanup.
See OQ-001. Use { "status": "ok", "data": { "name": "<name>", "dc": "<dc>" } } as the authoritative output format.
